issues.question: (Schedule C deduction substantiation, Schedule E loss, unreported wages/interest/rental income, SE tax) Are respondent's deficiency determinations for 2014-2016 correct?
issues.holding: Sustained; petitioner offered no credible evidence rebutting disallowed deductions or third-party-reported income.

issues.question: Is petitioner liable for section 6662(a) accuracy-related penalties for 2014, 2015 and 2016?
issues.holding: Yes; supervisory approval timely; understatement exceeds $5,000 (greater than 10% of tax required) each year; no reasonable cause shown.
issues.computable_reason: Substantial understatement is threshold arithmetic; 6751(b) satisfied on dates and no reasonable-cause defense raised (not assigned as error).

decision.text: Decision will be entered for respondent.
